(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas and the void.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes three composite patches respectively located on each of the first and second members. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape including reinforcing fibers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies having web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web, the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of composite fabric joined to the filler in the radius filler zone.
